alternative.src/weekly.mjs: export function occurrences(start,end,weekdays){const date=new Date(start+'T00:00:00Z'),stop=new Date(end+'T00:00:00Z'),set=new Set(weekdays),result=[];while(date<stop){if(set.has(date.getUTCDay()))result.push(date.toISOString().substring(0,10));date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate()+1);}return result;}

mutants.replacement: const day=86400000;export function occurrences(start,end,weekdays){const out=[];for(let t=Date.parse(start+'T00:00:00Z');t<Date.parse(end+'T00:00:00Z');t+=day){const d=new Date(t);out.push(d.toISOString().slice(0,10));}return out;}
